data.desc: Tillys is a leading specialty retailer of casual apparel, footwear, and accessories for young men, young women, boys and girls with an extensive assortment of iconic global, emerging and proprietary brands rooted in an active, social and outdoor lifestyle. Tillys is headquartered in Irvine, California and currently operates 220 total stores across 32 states, and its website, www.tillys.com.
